$comment: Manifest of third-party code committed into this repository.
Run `npm run sync-vendors` to refresh it, `npm run sync-vendors -- --check` to verify.
`sha256` values are recorded per destination file and checked on every run;
a mismatch means the file drifted from its declared upstream source.

vendors.name: react
vendors.syncNote: React 19 publishes no UMD build, so sync-vendors bundles the package into an IIFE that assigns window.React. The pages keep loading it with a plain <script> tag.
vendors.browserGlobalEntry:
import * as React from "react";
window.React = React;

vendors.name: react-dom
vendors.syncNote: React 19 publishes no UMD build and removed ReactDOM.render. The bundle entry exposes window.ReactDOM with createRoot plus a render() shim that caches one root per container and uses flushSync, so the existing pages keep working unchanged.

vendors.name: cometd
vendors.versionNote: The committed copy carries no version marker. Identified by fingerprint: cometd.d.ts matches the 8.0.x line exactly (and differs from 7.x and 9.x), and cometd.js matches 8.0.1+. 8.0.4 was the latest release when these files were added on 2024-09-06.
vendors.syncNote: The committed copy was minified locally, which is not reproducible. Syncing replaces it with the published (unminified) sources: Client.js grows from ~24 KB to ~81 KB.

vendors.name: prismjs
vendors.syncNote: The committed bundle came from the prismjs.com download builder (themes=prism-coy, languages=markup+clike+apex+json+log+sql), whose output is not reproducible by concatenating the npm files. Syncing rebuilds an equivalent bundle from npm in dependency order; the result is functionally equivalent but not byte-identical to the builder output.

bundle.note: Committed bundle is the download-builder output. `npm run sync-vendors -- --name prismjs` rebuilds an equivalent bundle from npm, but the bytes differ, so check syntax highlighting before committing the result.

files.note: Committed file is the prismjs.com download-builder output, not the published prism-coy theme. Syncing replaces it; verify the UI before adopting.

vendors.name: lightning-flow-scanner-core
vendors.syncNote: Built from source by `npm run build-flow-scanner`, which clones the upstream repository at tag core-v<version> and builds it. Not fetched by sync-vendors; run that script instead.

vendors.name: salesforce-lightning-design-system
vendors.licenseNote: The committed file is the internal "SLDS Plus" build. Its own banner states it is "for Design Systems Engineering team use only" and "may be withdrawn anytime", so its redistribution terms differ from the published @salesforce-ux/design-system package.
vendors.syncNote: No published artifact matches this build, so sync-vendors cannot fetch it. It is checksummed here so drift is still detected. Replacing it with the published @salesforce-ux/design-system package would make it automatable.
